name: Yangzhou Tinfulong Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Yangzhou Tinfulong Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of differentiated polyester staple fibers in China and internationally. The company offers recycled colored polyester staple fiber products, including customized colored series; and functional colored series, such as UV resistant, oleophobic and hydrophobic, colored flame-retardant staple, and colored low melting staple fibers. It also provides differentiated composite fiber products comprising low melting fibers; polyolefins fibers, which include hydrophobic, hydrophilic, and functionality; hot melt filaments; wet and dry-short cutting composite ultra short fibers; and PET film-grade chips.
